name: Inkbound IMAGE_INDEX
description: Curated game images for Inkbound, mirrored from atiffhussainkhan/Image. Character plates are CC0 figure idles (knight, princess, dragon, Kenney toons) plus 1024+ sphere beads. Stage plates are 4096 sky fields or 1024 parchment. Do not AI-generate bitmap art.

active_pack.note: Kenney CC0 assets mirrored via Image mega library release.

source_of_truth.plate_policy: Curated from shorepine-kenney high-resolution plates only: 4096 skyboxes, 1024 parchment and spheres, 512 splats, particles, and light masks. Pixel-platformer tiles are not used as stage or pattern art.

images.recommended_usage: Stage plate for Quiet Plane — 1024 cartography parchment
Stage plate for Rimward Marsh — 4096 day sky field
Stage plate for Sumi Basin — 4096 night sky field
Stage plate for Cinnabar Reach — 4096 warm sky field
Stage plate for Obsidian Shallows — 4096 deep sky field
Stage plate for Unsealed Horizon — 4096 dawn sky field
Ink picker bead overlay — double paint
Inkbound brand seal — double round button
Leader mark — shaded medal (densest plate in the pack)
Quiet Plane rim stamp — 1024 shaded foliage
